seo.title: Give
seo.description: Support the worship, teaching, community, and outreach of Temple Aviv Judea.

hero.title: Help the vision grow.
hero.intro: Your giving supports a lasting Messianic Jewish witness in Fullerton through worship, teaching, hospitality, and care for the community.

banner.imageAlt: Mosaic artwork of a ceremonial cup, lamb, and empty tomb at sunrise

givingIntro.heading: Give with purpose. Care for the family.
givingIntro.lead: You are part of our mishpachah, our family. Together, we care for people who need physical, spiritual, and financial support.
givingIntro.body: Your offering helps sustain Shabbat worship, biblical teaching, hospitality, ministry, and outreach. Donations are completed directly through Temple Aviv Judea’s existing PayPal account.
givingIntro.securityNote: Both options open the same Temple Aviv Judea PayPal checkout in a new tab. Temple Aviv Judea never receives or stores your card or bank information.

supportPanel.imageAlt: Mosaic artwork of the Temple and Western Wall with hands holding a golden heart and the words Give, Honor Hashem with your firstfruits
